label: Hepatit c
note: "Hepatit c" names hepatitis C, a liver disease that can cause jaundice; it is not a name for jaundice, so it does not belong among this term's labels. Found while drafting the explanations (SAL-13).

label: Kabartma tozu
note: "Kabartma tozu" is baking powder, a raising agent that contains sodium bicarbonate among other ingredients; it is not sodium bicarbonate itself. Found while drafting the explanations (SAL-13).

label: ugljikov oksid
note: "ugljikov oksid" (carbon oxide) is ambiguous and easily read as carbon monoxide (ugljikov monoksid), a different, toxic gas. It is this term's only Croatian label, so the cheatsheet shows it for carbon dioxide. Found while drafting the explanations (SAL-13).

label: grudna žlezda
note: "grudna žlezda" (chest gland) is a lay name for the thymus that is easily read as the breast (mammary) gland. It is this term's only Latin-script Serbian label, so the cheatsheet shows it; the medical name timus is missing here. Found while drafting the explanations (SAL-13).

label: грудна жлезда
note: "грудна жлезда" (chest gland) is a lay name for the thymus that is easily read as the breast (mammary) gland. It is the preferred label, so the cheatsheet shows it before тимус. Found while drafting the explanations (SAL-13).
